independenceNote: Speed-torque graph from ROBOTIS's own e-Manual.
methodNote: Speed and efficiency read off the e-Manual's N-T graph (about 0.02 N·m reading error). The graph does not print its voltage; the 12 V rating is assumed. The reading error is stated for torque only; our reading errors for speed and efficiency are not quantified. Points re-checked in November 2026 by pixel analysis of the source chart image.
note: The graph stops at 0.74 N·m, under half of the 1.6 N·m stall figure. Efficiency near stall reads unreliably: the 0.05 at 7 rpm implies less electrical input than the 22 rpm point at lower torque, which is unlikely. We could not re-check the graph, so treat the lowest-speed efficiency as approximate.
